1. Research question

Which training choices drive the reported top-1 accuracy on the held-out split?

2. Data and dataset

We use the public CorpusX benchmark with 50,000 training images and a 10,000 image held-out split.

3. Method and training setup

We train a ResNet-18 with momentum 0.9 and learning rate 0.1 for 60 epochs, using random crops.

4. Main results

Top-1 accuracy 88.2% and macro F1 0.871 on the held-out split.

5. Conclusion

Momentum and a longer schedule explain most of the reported gain.

6. Limitations and future work

The study covers one dataset only, so cross-domain transfer is left for future work.
